---
name: Button mapping report
about: A button is detected as a different button (from --monitor)
labels: hardware-mapping
---

Run `python3 bridge/mikrobe.py --monitor` (with the background bridge stopped), press each button, and fill in the table:

| Physical label on the Mikro | Printed name | Bit |
|---|---|---|
| F1 | | |
| F2 | | |
| F3 | | |
| CONTROL | | |
| NAV | | |
| ◀ (by screen) | | |
| ▶ (by screen) | | |
| MAIN | | |
| GROUP | | |
| BROWSE | | |
| SAMPLING | | |
| NOTE REPEAT | | |
| Encoder push | | |

Encoder: does turning clockwise print `+1`? yes / no

Pads: pressing the **bottom-left** pad prints `pad 1`? yes / no
